import re
out = open('sections.txt').read() if False else None
import subprocess
res = subprocess.run(['readelf','-S','/app/mystery'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
lines = res.splitlines()
secs = []
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    m = re.match(r'\s+\[\s*\d+\]\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+([0-9a-f]{16})\s+([0-9a-f]{8})\s+([0-9a-f]+)\s+([0-9a-f]+)\s+(\S+)', l)
    if m:
        name, typ, vma, off, size, entsz, flags = m.groups()
        secs.append((name,typ,int(vma,16),int(size,16),flags))
for s in secs: print(s)
EOF
